title: 第5章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇这是一家私人会所，倾尽所有的奢侈为那些豪门贵族提供最优质的服务，在这个地方接风，叶芊沫很满意，算这个丫头还有良心。三年前，顾佳泞在娱乐圈只是一个毫不起眼的新人，去法国参加电影节，也不过是一个打酱油的，当她在街头闲逛的时候，救下了差点被车撞到的小奶娃，而那时候，叶芊沫还是一个默默无闻的设计师。于是不得志的两个人决定联手为彼此赢得一次机会。一件唯美的白色礼服，不仅让顾佳泞在走红毯的时候，力压各类明星大腕，成为当天的焦点，也让叶芊沫一战成名，获得了时装界女王凯琳大师的亲睐。从此，顾佳泞片约不断，凭借精湛的演技迅速成为当红一线影星，身价千万，而叶芊沫也从此跻身顶尖时装界，用一件又一件设计，让星空这个名字享誉全球。贵宾包房内，布局奢华至极，姐妹一年不见，按理说应该亲热个没完没了的，然而事实却是……“你说什么！”叶芊沫一拍桌子站起来，不顾形象的大吼，“死丫头，你再给我说一遍！”靠，让她去求人？而且还不是别人，是欧慕瑄！开什么玩笑，她什么时候求过人？！“姐……”缩在沙发椅上的顾佳泞眨着无辜的眼睛，一张倾国倾城的脸上写满了恳求，“姐，你也知道，我合约到期了嘛，人家想去欧皇娱乐工作，姐，反正他是你男朋友，咱们是一家人嘛！”“谁跟你是一家人？”叶芊沫鄙视地看着她。“跟我姐夫欧慕瑄啊！”顾佳泞起身坐到叶芊沫身边，亲昵地抱着她的脖颈，“姐，你真了不起，人家情侣七年啊，这都逃不过你的魔抓。”“什么情侣七年？”这都是什么乱七八糟的。“欧慕瑄和莫含歆啊，他们七年前就订婚了，”顾佳泞直起身子，一本正经地说，“不过七年前，欧慕瑄一直是到处拈花惹草的花花公子，据说六年前出了一次车祸，然后就突然转性了，排斥所有的女人！”“……撞……撞弯了？”不对女人感兴趣，难道开始对男人……所以一直想要退婚，难道是因为这个原因？难怪六年前这厮挺禽兽的，现在都不愿意多看她一眼，之前她还觉得是自己魅力出了问题，原来是他的某种取向变了。既然他都对她不感兴趣了，那她还担心个毛线啊！“所以姐，你真厉害，连弯男都能掰直，你怎么做到的？”有事相求，顾佳泞自然要拍拍马屁。“说重点！”“帮帮我！”叶芊沫很是无语，“那么多的经纪公司抢着要你，你干嘛非要进欧氏？”“有欧慕瑄罩着，清白有保证啊，以后就再也不用牺牲色相去陪那些投资商了，”顾佳泞知道叶芊沫最心软了，“姐，你也不想看我整天在那堆臭男人面前卖弄风姿吧？”“好啦好啦，我考虑一下！”“姐？”“我答应我答应！”六年前，她感情失败，去酒吧买醉结果被人下药，然后失身，虽然这年头清白早已不算什么，可是为毛只要想起她那张妖孽脸，心就扑通扑通直跳啊！不行，叶芊沫，越害怕什么，你就越去面对，逃避只会加深恐惧感！聊到一半，叶芊沫起身去洗手间，然而在经过另一间包间的时候，门突然被打开，夹带着冷风，一张绝世的妖孽脸就这么突然出现在了叶芊沫的面前！琥珀色的眸子冰冷如刀，修长的身体染上一层逼人的戾气，让人退避三舍，此刻，他如同一只处在狂怒边缘的狼，仿佛随时有可能扑过来撕碎他的猎物！叶芊沫被他的眼神吓得下意识后退一步，靠，这不是在瞪她吧？她可什么事都没做。清雅至极的脸，无辜而充满防备的表情，像是一个受惊了的小猫咪，尤其是那漆黑的眸子，如无边的星空，仿佛可以吞噬一个人的灵魂。这样的表情，很熟悉，如同前两天在机场第一次看到她的那样，熟悉到让他的心里酸酸的，连同那片空白的地方一起，涩涩的，像是有什么东西即将从里面溢出……几秒钟的呆愣之后，叶芊沫迅速伪装好自己，高傲，自信，笑靥如花，“欧总，这么直直的盯着我，难道我脸上有什么东西？”眨眼间又是这么嚣张的样子，欧慕瑄微微眯起眼睛，似笑非笑地转过脸，“知道还不擦，在等本少爷帮你么？”靠，不会刚才吃东西的时候真的沾上什么了吧？叶芊沫疑惑地摸自己的嘴角，然而看到欧慕瑄眸子里的嘲笑，叶芊沫就知道自己中计了。尼玛，这么低级的错误居然会出现在她的身上，智商，智商哪去了？叶芊沫放下手，莞尔一笑，“逗你玩的。”“什么？”欧慕瑄皱眉。“刚刚看你那么怒气冲冲的，一点也不可爱，所以就故意逗逗你，”语气轻佻，像是在挑逗良家妇男那般，只说还不够过瘾，叶芊沫直接走过去，伸手拍拍他的肩膀，“骚年，放松一点！”语重心长地说完，一脸嚣张地离开。欧慕瑄看着她嚣张的身影，嘴角泛起一抹嗜血的笑意，女人，你以为这就是结束么？“瑄？”包房内，一个女人的声音疑惑地响了起来。欧慕瑄轻蔑一笑，长臂一身，一把将刚绕过他的叶芊沫拦了回来，趁她没站稳的时候，转而扣住她的腰，将其固定在怀里。等叶芊沫反应过来的时候，人已经在她的怀里动弹不得了。“死妖孽，你发什么神经？”叶芊沫挣扎不出。死妖孽？这就是她对他的称号？很好，女人，你的罪名又多了一条，毁谤！“我在报复。”“昂？”叶芊沫还没反应过来，欧慕瑄一把将她拦进包房，然后侧身向她，低头，亲吻！什……什么情况？叶芊沫完全傻眼了，六年前，他放肆的吻，霸道的占有，粗重的呼吸，再次回荡在她的脑海里……靠！敢吃老娘的豆腐，找死……只是还没等叶芊沫出手，欧慕瑄便放开了她，转过身体。“伯父，伯母，我爱的人是她，所以不会跟含歆结婚，抱歉！”没有这厮的高大的身体阻挡，叶芊沫这才看清包间内的情况，靠，这尼玛是人家双方家长在商量婚事啊。长长的餐桌上，一个个身份尊贵的男男女女，足足有十个，二十只眼睛就这么齐齐地瞪着她这个突然出现的第三者。她是有多冤枉？如果这时候她说她进错门了会不会显得太怂了？叶芊沫很是无辜地扫视四周，然后用敌视的目光狠狠地仰头等着欧慕瑄，妖孽，你等着瞧，此仇不报非女子！
content_en: Chapter 1 Encounter at the Bar This is a private club that spends all its luxury to provide the highest quality services to the rich and nobles. Ye Qianmo is very satisfied to be accepted in this place, because this girl still has a conscience. Three years ago, Gu Jiali was just an inconspicuous newcomer in the entertainment industry. She went to France to participate in a film festival and was just a soy sauce. When she was wandering on the street, she saved the little baby who was almost hit by a car. At that time, Ye Qianmo was still an unknown designer. So the two frustrated people decided to join forces to win a chance for each other. A beautiful white dress not only allowed Gu Jiali to outperform all kinds of celebrities and become the focus of the day when walking on the red carpet, but also made Ye Qianmo famous and won the favor of Master Kailin, the queen of the fashion industry. From then on, Gu Jiali continued to film, and with her superb acting skills, she quickly became a popular first-line movie star with a net worth of tens of millions. Ye Qianmo also joined the top fashion industry, using one design after another to make the name Xingkong famous all over the world. The layout in the VIP private room is extremely luxurious. The sisters have not seen each other for a year. It is logical that they should be affectionate endlessly, but the fact is... "What did you say!" Ye Qianmo slapped the table and stood up, yelling regardless of the image, "Damn girl, tell me again!" Damn, let her ask for help? And it’s none other than Ou Muchuan! Are you kidding me? When has she ever asked for help? ! "Sister..." Gu Jiali, who was huddled on the sofa chair, blinked innocent eyes, her alluring face full of pleading, "Sister, you know, my contract has expired, and I want to work at European Emperor Entertainment. Sister, he is your boyfriend anyway, and we are a family!" "Who is a family with you?" Ye Qianmo looked at her with contempt. "Follow my brother-in-law Ou Muxuan!" Gu Jiani stood up and sat next to Ye Qianmo, hugging her neck affectionately. "Sister, you are amazing. I have been a couple for seven years, and they can't escape your clutches." "What kind of couple has been together for seven years?" This is all such a mess. "Ou Muxuan and Mo Hanxin, they were engaged seven years ago," Gu Jiani straightened up and said seriously, "But seven years ago, Ou Muxuan was always a playboy who flirted with women. It is said that he had a car accident six years ago, and then he suddenly changed his gender and rejected all women!" No wonder this guy was quite a beast six years ago, but now he doesn't want to look at her again. Before, she thought there was something wrong with her charm, but it turned out that something in his orientation had changed. Since he was no longer interested in her, what was she worried about? "So, sister, you are so awesome. You can even straighten a crooked man. How did you do it?" Gu Jiating naturally wanted to flatter her when she asked for something. "Let's get to the point!" "Help me!" Ye Qianmo was speechless, "So many brokerage companies are vying for you, why do you have to join Ou's?" "With Ou Muxuan's protection, your innocence is guaranteed. From now on, you no longer have to sacrifice your appearance to accompany those investors." Gu Jianing knew that Ye Qianmo was the most soft-hearted, "Sister, you don't want to see me here all day long. Are you showing off in front of those stinky men?" "Okay, okay, let me think about it!" "Sister?" "I promise, I promise!" Six years ago, her relationship failed, she went to a bar to get drunk and was drugged, and then she lost her virginity. Although being innocent these days is nothing, whenever she thinks about her evil face, her heart will beat loudly! No, Ye Qianmo, the more you are afraid of something, the more you have to face it. Avoiding it will only deepen the fear! In the middle of the conversation, Ye Qianmo got up and went to the bathroom. However, when passing another private room, the door was suddenly opened, bringing with it a cold wind, and a peerless evil face suddenly appeared in front of Ye Qianmo! His amber eyes were as cold as knives, and his slender body was tainted with a layer of overwhelming violence that made people retreat. At this moment, he was like a wolf on the edge of rage, as if he might pounce at any time and tear his prey to pieces! Ye Qianmo was so frightened by his eyes that she subconsciously took a step back. Damn, wasn't he glaring at her? She didn't do anything. The extremely elegant face, the innocent and defensive expression, is like a frightened kitten, especially the dark eyes, like the boundless starry sky, which seems to be able to swallow a person's soul. This expression was very familiar, just like the first time he saw her at the airport two days ago. It was so familiar that it made his heart sour. Together with the blank space, it was astringent, as if something was about to spill out from it... After a few seconds of silence, Ye Qianmo quickly disguised herself, arrogant, confident, smiling With a dimple like a flower, "Mr. Ou, you are staring at me so straight, is there something on my face?" Looking so arrogant again in the blink of an eye, Ou Muchuan narrowed his eyes slightly and turned his face with a half-smile, "You know you don't wipe it yet, are you waiting for me to help you?" Damn, didn't you really get something on it when you ate just now? Ye Qianmo touched the corner of her mouth in confusion, but when she saw the ridicule in Ou Muchuan's eyes, Ye Qianmo knew that she had fallen into a trap. Damn it, such a low-level mistake actually happened to her. Where did her IQ go? Ye Qianmo put down her hand and smiled, "I'm just teasing you." "What?" Ou Muxuan frowned. "I saw you so angry just now. It's not cute at all, so I deliberately teased you," the tone was frivolous, as if teasing a good man, but it was not enough. Ye Qianmo walked over directly, reached out and patted his shoulder, "Sao Nian, relax!" After saying this seriously, she left with an arrogant look. Ou Muxuan looked at her arrogant figure with a bloodthirsty smile on his lips. Woman, do you think this is the end? "Xuan?" A woman's voice sounded suspiciously in the private room.
